entries.4e7ec630856e09fc: New vehicle sales of Nissan Motor.
entries.577cae8f2402ac8d: It has a single segment, automobile-related business, and all revenue is from Japan (mainly Tokyo). Sales are mainly new vehicles at ¥65,590 million and used vehicles at ¥21,995 million, and there is no counterparty accounting for 10% or more of revenue from external customers. Its structure makes results susceptible to trends in new vehicle registrations in Tokyo and the breadth of the Nissan product lineup.
entries.5c7ea78e493a6a1a: Used vehicle sales. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were 21,661 units and ¥21,995 million.
entries.6e65ecf960c208d7: Individual and corporate automobile buyers and owners in Tokyo
entries.77b732b89190bfba: Automobile body repair and vehicle inspection maintenance and other services carried out by three companies: Nissan Tokyo Sales, NT Auto Service and Shakenkan.
entries.7ad59ae1282c3b58: The group consists of the company and eight subsidiaries (including three unconsolidated subsidiaries). Its core subsidiary, Nissan Tokyo Sales, plays the central role in sales and maintenance, and consolidated headcount for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 2,589.
entries.7c8512c82f4f0a7a: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,682 million, down from ¥4,312 million in the previous fiscal year. Owing to growth in the maintenance business and continued cost reductions, among other factors, results exceeded the earnings forecast announced on February 13, 2026.
entries.80296a4f785c61ef: New vehicle sales of Nissan Motor. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were 20,763 units and ¥65,590 million.
entries.84c6ea6ea425f4a0: It is working on a four-year Medium-Term Management Plan through fiscal 2026 (announced November 2022), and is promoting three priority growth strategies: 'Electrification Leader,' 'Safety and Driving Support Technologies,' and 'Mobility Business.' Its investment strategy plans investment on a scale of ¥30 billion, unprecedented in the past, and it has pushed ahead with it ahead of schedule, focusing on the first half of the medium-term plan period. It plans to link initiatives in fiscal 2026, the final year, to the next medium-term management plan starting in fiscal 2027.
entries.9a3b39d6078bbebf: Sales of automotive parts and accessories. Amounts by segment are not disclosed.
entries.a1ad6f9e38110a86: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥128,997 million, down 8.9% year on year. The main cause was a decrease in new and used vehicle sales volumes. Sales results were ¥65,590 million for new vehicles and ¥21,995 million for used vehicles.
entries.a4bc81d4e7408789: New vehicles (Nissan Motor's passenger cars, kei cars, electric vehicles, etc.)
entries.ba4e54106eb5dc6d: It has know-how accumulated through more than 15 years of electric vehicle (EV) sales experience, and has an extensive lineup of electrified vehicles, from kei cars to SUVs, including EVs and e-POWER vehicles. It is also built on a stable stock business based on its customers.
entries.be3d644becfda93e: It is the only reportable segment of the group. The core subsidiary Nissan Tokyo Sales purchases automobiles and parts and accessories from Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. and its group companies and sells them, and Nissan Tokyo Sales, NT Auto Service and Shakenkan (3 companies) carry out vehicle body repair and vehicle inspection maintenance, among others. It accounts for almost all of consolidated revenue of ¥128,997 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.c25362012037e3e6: Automobile body repair and vehicle inspection maintenance and other services carried out by three companies: Nissan Tokyo Sales, NT Auto Service and Shakenkan. Amounts by segment are not disclosed.
entries.c6b00cda272ede87: The business model is one in which its core subsidiary, Nissan Tokyo Sales, purchases vehicles and parts and accessories from Nissan Motor and its group companies and sells them to customers in Tokyo, while group companies carry out vehicle inspections and maintenance.
entries.d532df200fcff629: It operates automobile-related businesses centered on one-stop car life services, including new vehicle sales, used vehicle sales, maintenance and insurance businesses. It also promotes individual lease sales and proposal-based sales.
entries.e08cd1d44dff31c2: The target is customers in Tokyo, the group's market. Registered vehicles of the group for the fiscal year ended March 2026 decreased 13.2% year on year.
